analysis:
This is an enhancement to the existing Bun/TypeScript monorepo, not greenfield. Exploration used direct Read/Grep/Glob because the codebase-memory MCP tools are unavailable in this host. All paths below are repository-root relative. No implementation or test execution was performed while drafting this PRD.

Architecture and boundaries: docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md:143 documents the nax-ai -> nax-agent -> nax dependency direction and the ACP peer boundary; :155 defines the 600-line source hard cap and external-call _deps seams. nax-agent must remain Node-compatible, use #src imports and explicit .ts relative imports, export supported symbols by name from src/index.ts, and keep private test seams on ./internal. nax uses Bun APIs and the @/chat barrel, not deep nax-ai imports. No nax-agent-acp or nax-ai implementation change is required: ACP lacks mid-turn input and native manual compaction capabilities, so optional capabilities and TUI fallback preserve compatibility. Regenerate packages/nax-agent/api/nax-agent.api.txt with bun run api:update for the intended public SteerResult, SteerChannel and CompactResult additions; do not bump package versions. All eight story IDs, workdirs and dependency lists are binding.

US-001, session steering: packages/nax-agent/src/session/agent-session.ts:74 currently stores an active claim without a kind discriminator; :115 send checks closed/busy/configuring, :144 installs claimTurn and clears the slot in onSettle, :191 runCommand installs a command claim, :245 shutdown aborts and awaits active settlement. Add claim kinds without weakening these exclusions or close behavior. The public optional AgentSession methods live in packages/nax-agent/src/session/agent-session-types.ts:183; SendTurnOpts starts at packages/nax-agent/src/session/session-types.ts:240. OpenedBackend's current optional methods are in packages/nax-agent/src/session/session-backend.ts:99; native-backend.ts:171 returns the native backend instance and should advertise steerable. packages/nax-agent/src/session/agent-session-turn.ts:34 defines TurnRunContext; :149 builds adapter.sendTurn options; :226 settles hooks before emitting turn_end. Turns are claimed synchronously but start on first iterator pull (:238), so allocate a per-claim channel early enough to accept a steer before adapter invocation, discard pending entries for voided claims, and resolve every applied promise once. Do not let channels leak across turns. packages/nax-agent/src/native/session/turn-loop-round-trip.ts:352 starts the loop and checks the deadline before compaction/model/tool work; :386 runTurnEndPhase currently returns early at the follow-up cap. Inject after tool results on later round boundaries and at turn-end, excluding aborted/stopped turns; the cap must constrain handler followUps only, not steers. Reset spinFlags.warned for steer continuations while preserving spin/deadline/invalid-call enforcement. Ordinary user-message persistence is handled by packages/nax-agent/src/native/session/turn-loop.ts:367 and :394; no new SessionEvent is needed. Existing tests to extend/mirror: test/unit/session/agent-session-chat.test.ts:1 and :16 use the scripted provider and shared helpers; test/unit/session/agent-session-run-command.test.ts covers command claims; test/unit/native/session/loop-events/before-turn-end.test.ts:72 covers capped continuation and stops, and test/unit/native/session/turn-loop-cancel.test.ts covers cancellation. outOfScope: Manual compaction does not dispatch the `before_compaction` loop event; plugin handlers see only proactive and overflow compactions.
`/compact` takes no argument; focus instructions for the summary are not supported.
Steering on ACP brains: the ACP protocol has no mid-turn user input, so ctrl+s interrupts and sends instead.
Queued messages are not persisted across a restart or a session switch, and cannot be edited or reordered in place.
A message carrying an image cannot be queued or steered.
No decode-speed row for replayed history or for a subagent's turns.
The terminal title does not show a separate marker for a pending approval or question.
No new `SessionEvent` type; the ACP server event translator is not changed.
